filum.digitalizza.tesseract_ticked_lines: Tesseract: ticked lines are erased from the picture and added as real lettering.
filum.digitalizza.the_background_colour_: The background colour: left out around the design and in plain holes (letter counters), left out only around it (every enclosed area stitched: a logo's white faces), or stitched everywhere
filum.digitalizza.the_border_colour_is_l: The border colour is left out where it reaches the edge of the picture, and in plain holes (letter counters, the inside of rings and outlines). Small enclosed areas (highlights) and ones with shapes on them (a badge face) are stitched.
The border colour is left out only where it reaches the edge of the picture: every area enclosed by the design is stitched (a logo's white faces inside its outlines).
The border colour is left out everywhere, also inside shapes (letter counters, holes).
filum.digitalizza.the_models_are_bundled: The models are bundled with {app} and run on this computer.
filum.digitalizza.the_one_you_always_use: the one you always use · suggested:
filum.digitalizza.the_palette_is_locked_: The palette is locked: regions stay where they are
filum.digitalizza.the_picture_s_colours_: The picture's colours on a grid of crosses — every colour setting (palette, thread chart, background, left-out areas, AI masks) applies.
filum.digitalizza.the_swatch_discs_a_and: The swatch: discs A and B, bars C and D
filum.digitalizza.thicken_the_stitch_lin: Thicken the stitch lines by this much (Ink/Stitch buffer): half the row spacing or more merges the rows of a fill into one shape
filum.digitalizza.thread_of_the_colour_e: Thread of the colour edges and the border
filum.digitalizza.traced_shapes_fills_sa: Traced shapes: fills, satin columns and lines.
filum.digitalizza.turns_stitches_back_in: Turns stitches back into shapes (Ink/Stitch Outline) — for designs from a machine file, so they can be re-stitched, resized or given new fills.
filum.digitalizza.very_thin_lines_become: Very thin lines become running stitch
filum.digitalizza.what_the_new_shapes_ar: What the new shapes are stitched as
filum.digitalizza.where_the_picture_has_: Where the picture has no clear flow, and at lower strength, rows lean this way.
filum.digitalizza.with_a_ruler_or_calipe: With a ruler or calipers, to a tenth of a millimetre. Measure the stitched area only, outside edge to outside edge.
filum.digitalizza.working_resolution_mor: Working resolution — more is slower but keeps finer shapes
filum.finestre.converti.breakApart.label: Break apart
filum.finestre.converti.breakApart.title: Repair a fill (crossing outlines, stray loops) and split it into its separate shapes

filum.finestre.converti.dedupe.title: Remove points that repeat (or nearly repeat) an earlier point of the path

filum.finestre.converti.patternSatin.tit: A satin along a line in a pattern: pearls, diamonds, squares, triangles, waves, arches
filum.finestre.converti.satinToRails.tit: A centre-line satin (or a line) as two editable rails with rungs
filum.finestre.converti.satinToStroke.ti: A running stitch along the middle of a satin column
filum.finestre.converti.zigzagToSatin.ti: A line drawn back and forth across a column (square, sawtooth or zig-zag) becomes a satin
